dry_remove_old: DRY RUN: would find and remove every older spaCR installation first
dry_create: DRY RUN: would create and validate %s
needs_free_space: spaCR needs at least 5 GB free while Python, Qt, PyTorch and dependencies install.
no_sudo: No sudo command was found. Continuing without optional Linux Qt libraries.
qt_help: If spaCR does not start, install your distribution's Qt/XCB/OpenGL runtime packages.
installing_linux_deps: Installing the small Linux graphics/runtime prerequisites...
unknown_package_manager: Unknown Linux package manager; continuing with the libraries already installed.
uv_missing: uv did not install at the expected path: %s
downloading_dependencies: Downloading spaCR, Qt, PyTorch and dependencies...
validating_install: Validating the installation before activating it...
removed: spaCR was removed. User-created data and preferences were left in place.
already_running: A spaCR installation is already running for this user.
ready_opening: spaCR is ready. Opening the application...
unsupported_platform: Unsupported platform. Use the Windows online installer on Windows.
desktop_comment: Spatial phenotype analysis of CRISPR screens
help_platform: Override automatic platform detection (linux or macos).
help_package_spec: Install SPEC instead of the released spaCR build.
help_torch_backend: PyTorch backend (default: auto; use cpu to disable hardware acceleration).
help_launcher_dir: Put the command launcher in PATH (mainly for CI).
help_no_command_launcher: Do not install a command-line launcher.
help_skip_system_deps: Do not install Linux Qt runtime libraries.
help_no_launch: Do not launch spaCR after installation.
help_dry_run: Print the resolved plan without downloading.
nsis_downloading: Downloading Python, Qt, PyTorch and spaCR. This can take several minutes.
nsis_failed: spaCR was not installed (exit code %s). An older spaCR may already have been removed. Run this installer again; install.log in the installation folder says what failed.
old_install_found: Found spaCR %s already installed at %s. This installer installs %s.
old_install_remove: Remove that installation completely before installing this one?
old_install_kept: Keeping it. The environment is replaced either way; caches and settings stay.
old_install_noninteractive: Not a terminal, so nothing was asked. The environment is replaced; caches and settings stay.
old_install_same: That is the same version this installer carries.
old_copy_not_removed: Installation stopped: an older spaCR could not be removed (see above). Close any running spaCR and run the installer again.
gui_explanation: Install private Python and spaCR dependencies in this window. No Terminal answers or administrator password are needed for this user runtime.
gui_public_reports: Anonymised error reports are on by default. They are filed as public GitHub issues by spaCR's relay, with no account needed, and never include paths, names, IP addresses, emails, tokens, logs, images or your content. spaCR AI (free) is also on by default. Turn reports off in Preferences → AI → AI Error report. The terms of use, Sections 5.6–5.7 and 6, give the details.
gui_share_diagnostics: Include redacted diagnostic logs in report previews
gui_report_issues: Enable the public GitHub issue-report action
gui_preserve: Your existing data, models, caches and preferences are kept. No optional cleanup is selected.
gui_cancelled: Installation cancelled. Review the log before retrying.
gui_failed: Installation or launch failed. Review the log and retry in this window.
gui_stopping: Stopping installation and restoring the previous runtime…
nsis_uninstall_failed: spaCR could not safely finish uninstalling. See the details above; your data has been kept.
help_without_wgpu: Install without wgpu; 3D views then use OpenGL or the CPU.
without_wgpu_description: Leaves out wgpu (Vulkan, Metal, Direct3D 12). spaCR then draws 3D views with OpenGL, or with the CPU when OpenGL is unavailable. Leave this unticked unless wgpu causes problems on this computer.
wgpu_plan_skip: skip (3D uses OpenGL, else the CPU)
wgpu_glibc_too_old: wgpu needs glibc 2.28 or newer (this system has %s); installing without wgpu, so 3D will use OpenGL or the CPU.
gui_uninstall_title: Remove all spaCR software from this Mac
gui_uninstall_explanation: Every spaCR installation listed below is removed, including older versions and spaCR inside your Python or Conda environments; the environments themselves and source checkouts are kept. Clear a category to keep its files. Removing the application asks for your administrator password.
gui_uninstall_admin: Enter your administrator password to remove the spaCR application.
gui_uninstall_done: spaCR was removed from this Mac.
gui_uninstall_failed: Uninstall stopped. Review the log; anything not listed as removed was kept.
gui_uninstall_no_python: No Python was found to remove per-user spaCR files; only the application can be removed here.
lease_held: %s is held by spaCR installer process %s. Wait for it to finish; if it stopped during a rollback, follow its installation log before retrying.
lease_held_unknown: %s was left by an earlier spaCR installer that did not record its owner. Close every spaCR installer, then remove it and retry.
lease_cleared: Removed a lock left by an interrupted spaCR installation whose process has ended: %s
